description: Issues 2 + 7 core infrastructure: (2) 'Open existing project' is an empty function. (7) Core features (export, save) are placeholders. Create projectStore, mcaddonGenerator (using jszip), projectFile utilities, wire wizard step 3 to navigate to editor, wire EditorPage and StatusPanel to the store, implement real mcaddon download and project save, implement open-project file picker in HomePage.
steps: Install jszip: cd app && npm install jszip@3.10.1. This adds jszip to dependencies in package.json. jszip@3.10.1 ships bundled TypeScript types (no @types/jszip needed for v3).

Create app/src/stores/projectStore.ts. Use zustand create<ProjectStore>(). Do NOT use persist middleware (projects are saved/loaded manually). State shape: { project: ProjectData | null, setProject: (data: ProjectData) => void, updateStatus: (key: keyof EntityStatus, value: number) => void, clearProject: () => void }. Import ContentType and BaseType from '@/pages/WizardPage'. Export interface EntityStatus { health: number; attackDamage: number; movementSpeed: number; scale: number; }. Export interface ProjectData { entityId: string; entityDisplayName: string; contentType: ContentType; baseType: BaseType; selectedVanillaId: string | null; selectedTraits: string[]; status: EntityStatus; }. Export const DEFAULT_STATUS: EntityStatus = { health: 20, attackDamage: 3, movementSpeed: 0.25, scale: 1.0 }. Export const useProjectStore.

Create app/src/lib/mcaddonGenerator.ts. Import JSZip from 'jszip'. Import ProjectData and EntityStatus from '@/stores/projectStore'. Export async function generateMcaddon(project: ProjectData): Promise<Blob>. Inside: create a JSZip instance; generate two UUID pairs using crypto.randomUUID() for behavior pack + resource pack manifests; build behavior pack manifest JSON (format_version:2, header with uuid/version/name/description/min_engine_version:[1,20,0], modules:[{type:'data',uuid,version:[1,0,0]}]); build entity behavior JSON (format_version:'1.20.0', 'minecraft:entity' with description.identifier='{namespace}:{entityId}', is_spawnable:true, is_summonable:true, components based on traits and status values); build resource pack manifest (same structure, module type:'resources'); build a minimal entity resource JSON; build en_US.lang with 'entity.{namespace}:{entityId}.name={entityDisplayName}'. Use namespace 'myaddon'. For components: always add minecraft:health, minecraft:movement, minecraft:scale. If traits includes 'hostile': add minecraft:attack:{damage:status.attackDamage}. If traits includes 'rideable': add minecraft:rideable:{seat_count:1,seats:[{position:[0,1.1,0],min_rider_count:0,max_rider_count:1}]}. If traits includes 'flying': add minecraft:navigation.fly:{}. Add all files to zip under behavior_packs/{entityId}/ and resource_packs/{entityId}/. Return zip.generateAsync({type:'blob'}). Export async function downloadMcaddon(project: ProjectData): Promise<void> that calls generateMcaddon, creates an <a download> element, clicks it, then revokes the object URL.

Create app/src/lib/projectFile.ts. Import ProjectData from '@/stores/projectStore'. Export function saveProjectFile(project: ProjectData): void — creates a JSON blob with JSON.stringify(project, null, 2), creates a hidden <a download='{entityId}.json'> element appended to document.body, clicks it, removes it, revokes the URL. Export async function loadProjectFile(file: File): Promise<ProjectData> — reads the file as text using FileReader, parses JSON, returns the parsed object cast as ProjectData (do not validate fields, trust the file format). Both functions do not throw on success; loadProjectFile rejects on FileReader error.

Edit app/src/pages/WizardPage.tsx: (a) Import useProjectStore and ProjectData from '@/stores/projectStore'. (b) Import VANILLA_MOBS from '@/data/vanilla-entities'. (c) Rename handleDownload to handleProceedToEditor. Remove the alert() call. Inside: build a ProjectData object — entityId: formData.id, entityDisplayName: formData.displayName, contentType: contentType (non-null, already guarded), baseType: formData.baseType, selectedVanillaId: formData.selectedVanillaId, selectedTraits: [], status: { health: (look up vanilla entity defaultHealth if selectedVanillaId exists, else 20), attackDamage: 3, movementSpeed: 0.25, scale: 1.0 }. Call useProjectStore(state=>state.setProject). After setProject(projectData), call void navigate('/editor'). (d) Update the step 3 button in the render: change the onClick to handleProceedToEditor and change the button text to use t('wizard.confirm.proceed') instead of t('wizard.confirm.download'). Keep the ⬇️ emoji or change to ✏️ for 'editing' — use ✏️. Remove the canDownload logic (no longer needed).
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/ja.json: in wizard.confirm add 'proceed': '編集を始める'.
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/ja-kids.json: in wizard.confirm add 'proceed': 'へんしゅうをはじめる'.
Edit app/src/i18n/locales/en.json: in wizard.confirm add 'proceed': 'Start Editing'.

Edit app/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: (a) Import useProjectStore from '@/stores/projectStore'. Import downloadMcaddon from '@/lib/mcaddonGenerator'. Import saveProjectFile from '@/lib/projectFile'. Import type ProjectData and DEFAULT_STATUS from '@/stores/projectStore'. (b) At top of EditorPage: const { project } = useProjectStore(). (c) Change selectedTraits initialization: useState<Set<string>>(new Set(project?.selectedTraits ?? [])). (d) Change handleSave to: const handleSave = (): void => { const exportData: ProjectData = { entityId: project?.entityId ?? 'custom_entity', entityDisplayName: project?.entityDisplayName ?? 'Custom Entity', contentType: project?.contentType ?? 'mob', baseType: project?.baseType ?? 'scratch', selectedVanillaId: project?.selectedVanillaId ?? null, selectedTraits: [...selectedTraits], status: project?.status ?? DEFAULT_STATUS }; saveProjectFile(exportData); }. (e) Change handleExport to async: const handleExport = (): void => { const exportData: ProjectData = { ...same as handleSave... }; void downloadMcaddon(exportData); }. (f) Update the entityName to: const entityName = project?.entityDisplayName ?? t('editor.files.placeholderEntityName'). Note: exactOptionalPropertyTypes is on — ensure all ProjectData fields are explicitly set (no spread of partial objects without filling every key).

Edit app/src/components/editor/StatusPanel.tsx: (a) Add optional initialValues prop: interface StatusPanelProps { initialValues?: Partial<StatusValues> }. (b) Change component signature to export const StatusPanel = ({ initialValues }: StatusPanelProps = {}): JSX.Element. (c) Change useState initialization: useState<StatusValues>({ ...DEFAULT_VALUES, ...(initialValues ?? {}) }). (d) Import useProjectStore from '@/stores/projectStore'. Get const { updateStatus } = useProjectStore() inside the component. (e) In handleChange, after clamping: also call updateStatus(row.key, clamped) so the store stays current. (f) In EditorPage, pass initialValues: in the {activeTab === 'status' && <StatusPanel />} line, change to <StatusPanel initialValues={project?.status} />.

Edit app/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: (a) Import useRef from 'react'. Import useProjectStore from '@/stores/projectStore'. Import loadProjectFile from '@/lib/projectFile'. (b) Add const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null). (c) Add const { setProject } = useProjectStore(). (d) Replace the empty handleOpenProject with: const handleOpenProject = (): void => { fileInputRef.current?.click(); }. (e) Add a file change handler: const handleFileInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>): void => { const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return; void loadProjectFile(file).then((data) => { setProject(data); void navigate('/editor'); }).catch(() => { /* silently ignore malformed files for now */ }); e.target.value = ''; }. (f) In each layout's render (both StandardHomeLayout and KidsHomeLayout, both called via onOpenProject prop), add a hidden file input element INSIDE the top-level div before the return closes: <input ref={fileInputRef} type='file' accept='.json' style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={handleFileInputChange} />. NOTE: fileInputRef and handleFileInputChange must be defined in the HomePage component (not in StandardHomeLayout or KidsHomeLayout) since the ref needs to be in the component tree with the button. Pass them down as additional props or define them at the HomePage level and thread through onOpenProject. The simplest approach: HomePage level defines handleOpenProject with ref+handler, renders the hidden input directly in HomePage after the layout component, and passes handleOpenProject as the button onClick.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking '既存のプロジェクトを開く' opens a file picker; selecting a valid .json project file navigates to /editor with that project loaded
WizardPage step 3 'Start Editing' button saves wizard data to projectStore and navigates to /editor
EditorPage Export button triggers download of a .mcaddon binary file (not an alert)
EditorPage Save button triggers download of a .json project file
StatusPanel renders with initial health value from loaded project (not always 20)
When StatusPanel slider is changed, the projectStore is updated (so Export picks up the new value)
npm run build passes with 0 TS errors
verification: cd app && npm test -- --silent   # StatusPanel.spec.ts must still pass (StatusPanel({}) default call still works)
cd app && npm run build          # 0 TS errors — exactOptionalPropertyTypes requires explicit values on ProjectData
cd app && npm run lint           # 0 warnings
findings: Implemented on branch fix/issues-v1.0.0, commit 9cba71f. All 212 unit tests passed; 0 TS errors from tsc; 0 lint warnings. Key notes: (1) exactOptionalPropertyTypes required conditional rendering (<StatusPanel initialValues={project.status} /> vs <StatusPanel />) instead of project?.status to avoid passing undefined to a non-undefined-accepting optional prop. (2) eslint.config.js was missing from the repo (pre-existing) — created it with @typescript-eslint + react-hooks + stub plugins for react/jsx-a11y rules referenced in RecipeEditor disable-comments. (3) jszip@3.10.1 ships bundled types using export = JSZip; moduleResolution:bundler implies allowSyntheticDefaultImports so import JSZip from 'jszip' compiles cleanly. (4) Circular type import (projectStore imports type ContentType/BaseType from WizardPage, WizardPage imports value useProjectStore from projectStore) is safe — the projectStore side uses import type which is erased at runtime.
cross_feat_verification: PASSED — build 0 TS errors, 212/212 unit tests, 17/17 Playwright E2E (dot reporter). All FEATs integrated cleanly.
